Corollary
[Standard solution is rotationally symmetric] ↗ def:standard-ricci-flow

Every $g(t)$ is invariant under the standard $SO(3)$ action.
Proof

\sketch Evolve the initial rotational Killing fields by (1). The maximum principle applied to (7), using cylindrical decay, gives $h=0$. The fields are stationary by (2), so the initial $SO(3)$ action remains isometric.

□

Proposition
[Non-collapsing of the standard flow]
